basics.name: Pavlo Golub
basics.label: Senior PostgreSQL Expert & Open Source Developer
basics.summary: Senior PostgreSQL expert with 20+ years of experience in database engineering, open source development, and technical leadership. Co-founder of PostgreSQL Ukraine, Google Summer of Code organization administrator, and maintainer of several PostgreSQL ecosystem tools.

work.name: CYBERTEC PostgreSQL International GmbH
work.summary: Consulting, performance tuning, high-availability clustering, and open source development for PostgreSQL customers worldwide.
highlights: Developed and maintained pg_timetable — advanced PostgreSQL job scheduler.
Developed and maintained pgwatch — non-invasive PostgreSQL monitoring tool.
Ported Patroni high-availability tool to Windows.
Delivered training and consulting to enterprise customers across Europe.

work.name: PostgreSQL Community
work.summary: Contributing to the PostgreSQL ecosystem through open source projects, community events, and mentorship.
highlights: Google Summer of Code organization administrator since 2023.
Speaker at PGConf Europe, PGDay Belgium, FOSDEM, Swiss PGDay, and other conferences.

volunteer.summary: Co-founded and helped grow the Ukrainian PostgreSQL community.
highlights: Organized meetups and conferences for Ukrainian PostgreSQL users and developers.

volunteer.summary: Administering PostgreSQL's participation in Google Summer of Code, mentoring student contributors.

certificates.name: Google Summer of Code Organization Administrator

projects.name: pg_timetable
projects.description: Advanced PostgreSQL job scheduler with support for SQL commands and system operations.
highlights: Superior to cron for PostgreSQL-related workflows.
Supports parallel and conditional job chains.

projects.name: pgwatch
projects.description: Non-invasive PostgreSQL monitoring tool with Grafana dashboards and multi-environment support.
highlights: No superuser rights or extensions required.
Supports AWS RDS, PgBouncer, Pgpool2, and Patroni.
Metrics stored in PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, or Prometheus.

projects.name: pgxmock
projects.description: Mock library for testing Go code that uses pgx PostgreSQL driver.
highlights: Supports named parameters and multiple result sets.
Widely used in the Go/PostgreSQL ecosystem.

projects.name: vip-manager
projects.description: Tool for managing Virtual IP addresses for PostgreSQL high-availability clusters.
highlights: Integrates with Patroni and other HA solutions.
Supports etcd, Consul, and Kubernetes for leader election.
